caption: The drawing features a centrally placed, intricately designed circular medallion with a radiating starburst pattern in its center. Surrounding the medallion, there are six bird-like figures, each with a prominent beak and stylized wings, arranged symmetrically around the circle. These figures are rendered in black and gray tones with scalloped and curved line details to suggest feathers and texture. At the top of the circle, there is an additional fan-shaped extension with lines radiating outward and a small circular hole at the center near its base. The entire composition is monochromatic, using grayscale ink or pencil on a plain, off-white background. In the bottom right corner, the name "I.M. Burgé." is written in small, capitalized letters.
title: Cut Tin Candle Holder
